**Bottom Line**
- **Mostly yes, with some caveats.** The 2024 record supports a reading that Scholz funded and managed social-policy areas through standard cabinet, budget, and administrative channels, with repeated use of technocratic and rule-based framing. I did **not** find strong evidence of social-service patronage networks; the main negatives are late-2024 governing breakdown, some confidential decision-making, and the structural BND oversight problem.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Budget 2025](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116) — Federal Government, 5 Jul 2024. Scholz said the budget would combine tax relief, social housing, infrastructure investment, and renewables, which is consistent with funding broad social supports through formal public budgets rather than patronage. `6B.4` `6B.2`

- [Olaf Scholz nennt Prioritäten für den Haushalt 2024](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2023/kw27-de-regierungsbefragung-954170) — Deutscher Bundestag, 31 Jan 2024. Scholz tied budget priorities to Bürgergeld, Wohngeld, higher child benefit, child supplement, and children’s basic security, showing social-service funding through programmatic state channels. `6B.4` `6B.2` `6B.3`

- [Summer press conference with Federal Chancellor Scholz](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040) — Federal Government, 24 Jul 2024. Scholz framed the welfare state, minimum-wage enforcement, basic-income support, and pension entitlements as core policy concerns, indicating social services were being managed as state functions rather than personal patronage. `6B.4` `6B.1` `6B.2`

- [Germany's Scholz says he will keep social agenda in budget deal](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/germanys-scholz-says-he-will-keep-social-agenda-in-budget-deal-3492843) — Reuters via Investing.com, 23 Jun 2024. Reuters reported that Scholz said the coalition would defend the welfare state and keep negotiating welfare benefits and new housing, which points to continued formal funding of social services. `6B.4` `6B.2`

- [Bundeskanzler Scholz zum Haushaltsgesetz 2024](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/bundeskanzler-haushalt-2257440) — Federal Government, 31 Jan 2024. Scholz condemned “remigration” rhetoric and backed democratic solidarity, which matters because it indicates social-state policy was being framed against exclusionary networks rather than captured by them. `6B.4` `6B.3`

- [Federal government cabinet results](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572) — Bundesregierung, 6 Mar 2024. The cabinet adopted traceability reforms for executive drafting and influence, a small but real anti-capture measure that supports professional administration over opaque patronage. `6B.4`

- [Bundesministerium der Finanzen interview with Kukies](https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Monatsberichte/Ausgabe/2024/11/Kapitel/kapitel-2-interview.html) — Bundesministerium der Finanzen, 21 Nov 2024. The finance ministry portrayed Kukies as a deeply experienced policy professional, which supports the view that Scholz relied on technocratic management in the budget and state apparatus. `6B.4`

- [Germany's coalition collapses what comes next](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936) — Reuters via Investing.com, 6 Nov 2024. The coalition collapse triggered political chaos and weakened continuity, which likely limited social-service execution late in the year; this is an implementation drag, not direct evidence of patronage. `6B.4`

**Counterweights**
- [BND surveillance ruling](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) — Bundesverfassungsgericht, 8 Nov 2024. The Court found parts of the surveillance framework unconstitutional and oversight inadequate, which is a structural weakness in state control systems even if it does not prove social-service patronage. `6B.4`

- [Germany's coalition collapses what comes next](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936) — Reuters via Investing.com, 6 Nov 2024. The coalition breakdown likely disrupted administrative continuity and delayed policy implementation, which weakens the case for smooth professional management in the second half of 2024. `6B.4`

- [Report on 5G security decision](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293) — Reuters via onvista, 23 May 2024. The confidential interministerial handling shows some important policy processes were not fully transparent in real time, which is a mild governance-negative for clean professional administration. `6B.4`

**Search Gap**
- I found **strong evidence for formal budgetary and technocratic management** of social policy.
- I found **little direct evidence of patronage networks inside social services**; the available material mostly argues against that pattern indirectly.
- I did **not** find strong direct evidence on front-line service administration quality by ministry or agency, so the conclusion rests mainly on budget design, cabinet process, and anti-capture signals rather than audited service-delivery outcomes.
